records.title: Large Language Models in Software Documentation and Modeling: A Literature Review and Findings
records.rationale: Literature review of LLMs for software documentation and modeling tasks; useful background on LLM4SE prompt techniques, datasets, and evaluation metrics, but it covers no agentic orchestration and offers no single- versus multi-agent evidence.

records.title: Evaluating Trustworthiness in AI: Risks, Metrics, and Applications Across Industries
records.rationale: AI trustworthiness governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC) across healthcare and finance; no LLM agents and no software engineering activity, so it fails the inclusion gate.

records.title: BonsAIDE: An Extended Vision for Human–AI Interaction in IDEs
records.rationale: BonsAIDE is a named IDE prototype with a 10-participant study on branching and pruning AI-generated code to contain hallucination and track provenance; informs verification and human-oversight aspects of RQ3 but studies a single assistant, not agent teams.

records.title: MCP-enabled agentic AI workflow for building energy modelling: framework and use cases
records.rationale: Directly contrasts conversational single-assistant MCP tool use against an agentic workflow of coordinating specialized agents on the same EnergyPlus tasks, which satisfies the any-domain single-versus-multi comparison clause even though the domain is building energy modelling.

records.title: Large language models in manufacturing: a comprehensive review
records.rationale: Systematic review of LLM applications across eight manufacturing sectors; the agentic framing is incidental, no software engineering task is studied, and no agent-configuration comparison is reported.

records.title: MAFSID: Multi‐Agent Few‐Shot Intrusion Detection for VANETs Through Rapid Collaborative Learning
records.rationale: MAFSID's five 'agents' are few-shot intrusion-detection classifiers for VANET traffic, not LLM-based agents, and the task is network security detection rather than a software engineering activity.

records.title: LLM - Driven Autonomous Cloud Automation Agent
records.rationale: Named LLM-driven agent architecture for cloud/DevSecOps operations evaluated on MTTR, policy-enforcement accuracy, and responsiveness against traditional automation; supplies single-agent operations evidence for the operations end of the SE activity range.

records.title: PreEduAI: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Automated Preschool Curriculum Development
records.rationale: Four-role multi-agent framework benchmarked against standalone GPT-4.1, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Llama-3-8B, and Gemini-2.5-Pro with an ablation isolating the collaboration gain (+0.95); a usable out-of-domain data point on when role specialization beats a single model, but the task is curriculum authoring, not software.

records.title: Conversational AI-Powered Multi-Agent System for Mobile Application Accessibility Compliance: A RAG-Enhanced Pipeline Design
records.rationale: Dual-agent RAG pipeline (Problem Analysis plus Solution Support) for mobile accessibility compliance and remediation is a named role-specialized architecture applied to an SE review/repair activity, though the paper reports only a design with hedged, unmeasured benefit claims.

records.title: A 2030 Roadmap for Software Engineering
records.rationale: Community roadmap editorial spanning AI for SE, verification and validation, and sustainable SE; useful for framing RQ1 future-work and sustainability discussion but contributes no architecture, benchmark, or failure-mode data.

records.title: Automated worker action recognition in construction videos via domain-adapted vision-language fusion
records.rationale: Vision-language model for recognizing construction worker actions in video; a computer-vision application with no LLM agents and no software engineering task.

records.title: UGV-UAV Integration Advancements for Coordinated Missions: A Review
records.rationale: Review of UGV-UAV robotic coordination protocols and swarm intelligence; the multi-agent systems here are robotics platforms, explicitly outside the LLM-agent scope.

records.title: Chain-of-programming (CoP): empowering large language models for geospatial code generation task
records.rationale: Chain-of-Programming decomposes geospatial code generation into five staged roles with a shared information pool and reports 3.0-48.8% gains plus ablations showing each component's necessity; relevant decomposition-versus-monolithic-prompt evidence for a code generation task.

records.title: Envisioning Recommendations on an LLM-Based Agent Platform
records.rationale: One-line vision piece on LLM agents for recommender systems; no software engineering activity, no architecture detail, and no agent-configuration comparison.

records.title: Proceedings of the 2024 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
records.rationale: Conference-proceedings container record whose attached abstract is a remote-work and parenting diary study; not a topical study and unusable as evidence.

records.title: Generative AI and Empirical Software Engineering: A Paradigm Shift
records.rationale: Vision paper on how LLMs and autonomous agents break empirical SE constructs, reproducibility, and threats to validity; directly informs how the review should read agent-evaluation claims and their ecological validity.

records.title: Consistency Checking of Functional and Non‐Functional Requirements in Self‐Adapting Systems
records.rationale: UML sequence diagrams transformed to timed automata and checked in UPPAAL for self-adaptive systems; classical model checking with no LLM component at all.

records.title: AI-Powered Building Ecosystems: A Narrative Mapping Review on the Integration of Digital Twins and LLMs for Proactive Comfort, IEQ, and Energy Management
records.rationale: Narrative review of digital twins and deep reinforcement learning agents for building comfort and HVAC energy management; the autonomous agents are DRL controllers, not LLM agents, and the domain is not software engineering.

records.title: Yuma: Geração de Workflows Multiagentes a partir de Linguagem Natural
records.rationale: Topically close (agents playing Requirements Engineer and Software Architect roles to generate multi-agent workflows) but the paper is published in Portuguese in the WebMedia extended proceedings, so the preregistered non-English exclusion applies.

records.title: Multi-Agent Assisted Automatic Test Generation for Java JSON Libraries
records.rationale: JsonATG is a role-specialized multi-agent test-generation system (code summarization agent plus test validation agent) benchmarked against two state-of-the-art LLM-based ATG methods on coverage, with 59 confirmed bugs and an explicit $25 budget, giving comparative and cost evidence for RQ2 on a real SE task.

records.title: Contemplative Agent
records.rationale: Single-agent CLI design essay built on four architectural principles including capability limitation and decaying memory; the memory and containment ideas are mildly informative for agent architecture but no SE task or evaluation is reported.

records.title: ARM: Autonomous Remediation and Management With LLM Agents for Intent-Driven Control
records.rationale: ARM applies LLM agents to root-cause analysis and remediation over MCP tooling with a reproducible benchmark, reporting only 52.9% SLA-violation identification accuracy and 70.7% mitigation success, which is concrete reliability-ceiling evidence for the operations setting.

records.title: Prompting for Performance: Exploring LLMs for Configuring Software
records.rationale: Empirical evaluation of several LLMs on software configuration tasks (option identification, configuration ranking and recommendation) that documents hallucination and superficial reasoning as concrete limitations of prompt-only single-model use.

records.title: Large Language Model for Vulnerability Detection and Repair: Literature Review and the Road Ahead
records.rationale: Systematic review of 58 papers on LLMs for vulnerability detection and repair with an explicit limitations and roadmap section; strong background for the verification and security dimension of RQ3 but not agent-architecture focused.

records.title: AI-Powered Educational Agents: Opportunities, Innovations, and Ethical Challenges
records.rationale: SLR of LLM-based educational agents; its comparison is hybrid human-AI tutoring versus fully autonomous tutoring rather than single-agent versus multi-agent, and no SE activity is involved.

records.title: AI and consumer behavior: Trends, technologies, and future directions from a scopus-based systematic review
records.rationale: PRISMA review of AI in consumer behavior and marketing; keyword overlap on AI adoption only, with no agents and no software engineering content.

records.title: Cognitive Bridge: AI-Generated Boundary Objects for Cross-Functional Collaboration
records.rationale: Controlled study with 16 designer-developer dyads where an AI system generates boundary objects, reporting 47% fewer communication conflicts but a premature-convergence tradeoff; an instructive human analogue for cross-role handoff loss, not an LLM multi-agent system.

records.title: Decoding China's Industrial Policies
records.rationale: Economics working paper that uses LLMs to classify three million Chinese industrial-policy documents; LLM-as-annotator in an economics study, with no agents and no software engineering task.
